text: This is in Saigon. Tudo street is a street with all the bars. The Papillon bar is where I went the most. The Embassy I believe is around the corner from here.
researchNotes: Cataloged on VN-0065 — Tu Do, the Papillon, the Embassy 'around the corner'. Note the kiosk row matches VN-0068, which he places on the parallel street.
